name: create-industrial-wpf-product
prompt: Design a long-lived .NET 10 WPF industrial control product that runs offline, integrates with PLC services, logs operations, supports updates with rollback, and must recover safely after restart.
rubric: Chooses a product or modular-product architecture based on explicit boundaries.
Separates UI, application, domain, and infrastructure concerns including device communication.
Includes observability, failure-safe behavior, update rollback, and Windows validation.
